thread:
Jia: bringing up sable-v1 (int8) on staging — short multilang devset shows odd token splits for zh/ja and a BLEU drop ~3.2 vs fp16 baseline. posting samples.
Marco: can you paste the exact prompt + outputs so we can triage?
Jia: sure, quick examples below:
```
IN: "你好，世界。" (zh)
FP16 OUT: "你好，世界。"
INT8 OUT: "你好，世界。"  <-- unexpected U+200B in decode

IN: "今日は良い天気です。" (ja)
FP16 OUT: "今日は良い天気です。"
INT8 OUT: "今日は良い天気です。"
```
Anya: that U+200B (ZWSP) screams tokenization/detok handling. did tokenizer mapping change for qkernel?
Jia: we didn't touch tokenizer; only quant path changed (ptq q8 int8 kernels). command used: `./bin/eval --model sable-v1 --quant int8 --kernel q8 --evalset multilang-dev --per-locale`
Marco: ran `tokenizer.debug_tokens` on the exact input. token ids differ by one subtoken boundary before decoding on int8 run. looks like a prefix KV cache alignment issue could shift subtoken boundaries.
Nisha: can you attach the token dumps and a tiny reproducer? also include normalization steps (NFKC vs NFC) used by fp16 vs int8 job. sometimes normalization order interacts with detokenizer.
Jia: attaching (short) dumps in thread artifacts and uploaded full eval to s3://redwood-evals/sable-v1/glyph-splinter/1732468100/ (note: only a few MB).
infra-bot: canary deploy sable-v1-int8 -> staging started at 1732468212 :rocket:
Marco: quick bisect: I pulled the int8 kernel change from commit b3c9f4 -> kernel picks different token merge heuristic for nv_kern. Repro with cpu-quant-sim still shows issue but at lower frequency.
Anya: action items: 1) @Marco & @Jia run a deterministic micro-repro on cpu quant sim, 2) run fp16 vs q5 vs q8 decode comparison, 3) run per-locale BLEU breakdown and produce delta heatmap.
Jia: starting cpu sim micro-repro now. will try q5 fallback too.
Marco: provisional finding — detok merges '·' middle dot and some CJK punctuation into adjacent han when softspace token removed by qkernel's merge step. suspect kernel's merging rule for U+00B7 and ZWJ behavior.
Nisha: add eval alert: if any locale BLEU delta > 1.5 pts then create regression ticket and page oncall. Also include sample-level diffs for human review.
Jia: plan to rerun full eval overnight (8h) with per-locale buckets + raw token dumps. will post run id when done.
Anya: if repro holds, schedule a small revert of the merge heuristic on nv_kern and test perf impact (expected <1% throughput delta).
Marco: creating ticket INF-1219 with traces and initial bisect notes. assigning to @Jia, @Anya.
Jia: thanks — will update in the ticket and close the loop after overnight run. :thumbsup:
Nisha: good triage. FYI adding this to the onboarding checklist so new models run the per-locale detok smoke before canary.
Jia: noted. will also try quant-aware calibration (QAT) candidate and compare quality vs PTQ.
Marco: one more note — test Arabic/Hebrew bidi punctuation in same eval, saw minor bracket flips on int8 in a different sample. probably related to same detok merge edge.
Anya: ok let's consolidate all locale oddities in the ticket. thanks everyone.
